display.name: 加速卡资源
display.description: 统一核心图表；来源特有指标列于专属诊断。单位见标题，统计差异见图表提示。

display.name: 加速卡利用率（%）
display.description:
指标含义
每张 DCU 卡的设备利用率采样值。按节点和卡号分别展示；不是整个集群的平均值，也不是显存容量使用率。

DCU 环境。图例区分节点、角色、实例、设备或统计分位数；筛选器仅改变所选序列，不自动生成集群去重汇总。

spec.query: (dcu_utilization_percent{node=~"$node",device=~"$device",environment="dcu-pd",node=~"$role"} * 1) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}) < 15)) and on(job,instance) (dcu_sample_success == 1 and (time() - dcu_sample_timestamp_seconds < 15))

display.name: 加速卡显存已用（GiB）
display.description:
指标含义
每张 DCU 卡的已用显存字节数除以 2^30。按卡展示绝对容量；要判断显存是否接近耗尽，还需结合该卡总容量。

DCU 环境。图例区分节点、角色、实例、设备或统计分位数；筛选器仅改变所选序列，不自动生成集群去重汇总。

spec.query: (dcu_memory_used_bytes{node=~"$node",device=~"$device",environment="dcu-pd",node=~"$role"} * 9.313225746154785e-10) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}) < 15)) and on(job,instance) (dcu_sample_success == 1 and (time() - dcu_sample_timestamp_seconds < 15))

display.name: 加速卡温度（°C）
display.description:
指标含义
每张 DCU 卡的当前设备温度。按节点和卡号区分；该图未设置统一安全温度阈值，应结合具体设备规格和历史基线判断。

DCU 环境。图例区分节点、角色、实例、设备或统计分位数；筛选器仅改变所选序列，不自动生成集群去重汇总。

spec.query: (dcu_temperature_celsius{node=~"$node",device=~"$device",environment="dcu-pd",node=~"$role"} * 1) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}) < 15)) and on(job,instance) (dcu_sample_success == 1 and (time() - dcu_sample_timestamp_seconds < 15))

display.name: 加速卡功耗（W）
display.description:
指标含义
每张 DCU 卡的当前功率采样值。瓦特表示瞬时功率，不是累计耗电量；耗电量需要对功率随时间积分。

DCU 环境。图例区分节点、角色、实例、设备或统计分位数；筛选器仅改变所选序列，不自动生成集群去重汇总。

spec.query: (dcu_power_watts{node=~"$node",device=~"$device",environment="dcu-pd",node=~"$role"} * 1) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~"$role"}) < 15)) and on(job,instance) (dcu_sample_success == 1 and (time() - dcu_sample_timestamp_seconds < 15))

display.name: 加速卡显存总量（GiB）
display.description:
指标含义
每张设备实际显存容量，配合已有已用显存曲线判断余量。

DCU 环境；实例、节点或 rank 分线展示，复制数据不直接相加。

spec.query: ((dcu_memory_total_bytes{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-prefill|dcu-decode",node=~"$node",device=~"$device",node=~"$role"} and ((time() - timestamp(dcu_memory_total_bytes{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-prefill|dcu-decode",node=~"$node",device=~"$device",node=~"$role"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(dcu_memory_total_bytes{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-prefill|dcu-decode",node=~"$node",device=~"$device",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-prefill|dcu-decode",node=~"$node",node=~"$role"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-prefill|dcu-decode",node=~"$node",node=~"$role"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-prefill|dcu-decode",node=~"$node",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-prefill|dcu-decode",node=~"$node",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)))))) / 1024^3 and on(job,instance) ((dcu_sample_success{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-prefill|dcu-decode",node=~"$role"} == 1) and (time() - dcu_sample_timestamp_seconds{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-prefill|dcu-decode",node=~"$role"} < 15))

指标含义
每卡已用显存 / 总显存，要求 DCU 采样成功且新鲜。

DCU 环境；实例、节点或 rank 分线展示，复制数据不直接相加。
